claims.statement: Public documentation for agents and developers.

Commonworld's own paid check (research observation, micropay test 2026-11-01): the live 402 of https://api.hyperextend.xyz/v1/trades/coverage asked 0.001 USDC on Base (x402 v2, scheme exact, payTo 0x548fC289526ab2F0391D562a723cdA64Bbf1abc4, the same Base payTo as the earlier unpaid candle probe); its description says floor $0.001 + $0.05 per archived hour examined, but the exact amount stayed 0.001 USDC for every window tried. Commonworld paid once (coin BTC, last hour) and got a real but empty answer (archived_hours_examined 0: the last hour was not archived yet). Settlement: Base tx 0x68bde26fd28ac2589a905c30f58b628cbfc6bfcf93d4e69577fa92477a8d5a6c (block 53349613), 0.001 USDC to that payTo. The candle route /v1/candles/BTC/1m/latest asked 0.002 USDC on the 2026-10-23 unpaid probe.

history.statement: Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid GET to https://api.hyperextend.xyz/v1/candles/BTC/1m/latest answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme batch-settlement, exact; network Base, Hyperliquid; asset USDC; price 0.002 USDC; payTo Base 0x548fC289526ab2F0391D562a723cdA64Bbf1abc4; plus 1 other network option(s)). YourAITools lists the price as $0.001–$0.002. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works. The probed route is not the cheapest one listed.
